description: Public Parking Counts at Port Authority of NY NJ Airports: Beginning 2002 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey quarterly produces a data file and provides information on count of the number of vehicles in the airport public parking lots. This dataset represents the number of cars parked in public parking lots at John F. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are parking, cars, airport, the port authority of new york & new jersey. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of New York & New Jersey. The portal shows 2016-10-31 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
